title: API error
description: Error body of the /v1/ endpoints and of the content gate. bad_request (400), unknown_purchase (404), store_unreachable (502, Google could not be reached), pass_required and pass_expired (401 from the content gate), unauthorized (401 from /v1/rtdn), keys_unreachable (502 from /v1/rtdn, Google's signing keys could not be read), not_configured (503, a binding, variable, or secret the endpoint needs is not set), not_found (404), method_not_allowed (405), internal (500).
